extensions_enabled.description: Enable extension handling. Supported values are y or n.

provisioning_agent.description: Which provisioning agent to use. Supported values are "auto", "waagent", "cloud-init", or "disabled".

provisioning_delete_root_password.description: Delete root password after provisioning. Supported values are y or n.

provisioning_regenerate_ssh_host_key_pai.description: Regenerate SSH host key pair after provisioning. Supported values are y or n.

provisioning_ssh_host_key_pair_type.description: SSH host key pair type. Supported values are "rsa", "dsa", "ecdsa", "ed25519", and "auto".

provisioning_monitor_host_name.description: Monitor host name changes and publish changes via DHCP requests. Supported values are y or n.

provisioning_decode_custom_data.description: Decode CustomData from Base64. Supported values are y or n.

provisioning_execute_custom_data.description: Execute CustomData after provisioning. Supported values are y or n.

provisioning_allow_reset_sys_user.description: Allow reset password of sys user. Supported values are y or n.

resource_disk_format.description: Format if unformatted. If 'n', resource disk will not be mounted. Supported values are y or n.

resource_disk_filesystem.description: File system on the resource disk. Typically ext3 or ext4. FreeBSD images should use 'ufs2' here.

resource_disk_mount_point.description: Mount point for the resource disk.

resource_disk_enable_swap.description: Create and use swapfile on resource disk. Supported values are y or n.

resource_disk_swap_size_mb.description: Size of the swapfile in MB. 0 means no swap.

resource_disk_mount_options.description: Comma-separated list of mount options. See mount(8) for valid options.

logs_verbose.description: Enable verbose logging. Supported values are y or n.

logs_collect.description: Enable periodic log collection. Supported values are y or n.

logs_collect_period.description: How frequently to collect logs in seconds, default is each hour.

os_enable_fips.description: Is FIPS enabled. Supported values are y or n.

os_openssl_path.description: If "None", the system default version is used. Otherwise, specify the path to the OpenSSL library.

os_ssh_dir.description: Set the path to SSH keys and configuration files.

os_enable_firewall.description: Add firewall rules to protect access to Azure host node services. Supported values are y or n.
